Class MotorResetMonitor

java.lang.Object
frc.spectrumLib.mechanism.MotorResetMonitor
public final class MotorResetMonitor extends Object
Tracks whether a motor has rebooted since its position was last set, so a homed mechanism stops trusting a position that restarted from the boot value.

A TalonFX that browns out or loses power keeps its flash config, but its position restarts from the boot value and its status-signal rates go back to defaults. Its Connected input comes back true, so nothing else notices.

Two halves, split at the log. filter(boolean, boolean) runs on the robot before the reading is logged, and turns Phoenix's raw flag into the logged ResetOccurred input. update(boolean, boolean) and positionRestored() run on that logged input, so they replay.

    • filter

      public boolean filter(boolean connected, boolean rawReset)
      Turns Phoenix's raw reset flag into the logged input. Robot side only: in replay the logged value replaces the result.
      Parameters:
      connected - the motor answered this loop
      rawReset - hasResetOccurred() this loop, which must be called every loop so a first-contact report is consumed
      Returns:
      the flag to log

      Returns:
